## Revision and environment

Identify Service revision, Python version, operating system, and Library
version or commit.

## Observed behavior

Describe what happened, including the exception type and message.

## Expected behavior

Describe the documented Service behavior expected.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the smallest safe reproduction without credentials, private data, or
vulnerability details.

## Boundary and evidence

State any public-interface, compatibility, security, cryptography, or ownership
effect. List evidence and its limits.
